description: This file defines the 'Project' class and related functions for managing project data, including task creation, progress updates, costing, and email notifications within the ERPNext system.

classes.name: Project
classes.description: Represents a project entity with methods for managing project lifecycle, tasks, costing, and notifications.

methods.name: get_feed
methods.description: Returns a formatted string with project status and name.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Loads activity summary data for the project.

methods.name: before_print
methods.description: Prepares data before printing the project report.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates and updates project data before saving.

methods.name: copy_from_template
methods.description: Copies tasks from a project template if applicable.

methods.name: create_task_from_template
methods.description: Creates a new task based on template task details.

methods.name: calculate_start_date
methods.description: Calculates the start date for a task, adjusting for holidays.

methods.name: calculate_end_date
methods.description: Calculates the end date for a task, adjusting for holidays.

methods.name: update_if_holiday
methods.description: Adjusts a date if it falls on a holiday.

methods.name: dependency_mapping
methods.description: Maps task dependencies based on template data.

methods.name: check_depends_on_value
methods.description: Sets task dependencies if not already set.

methods.name: check_for_parent_tasks
methods.description: Sets parent task relationships.

methods.name: is_row_updated
methods.description: Checks if a row has been updated compared to existing data.

methods.name: update_project
methods.description: Updates project progress, costing, and status.

methods.name: after_insert
methods.description: Actions after inserting a new project.

methods.name: on_trash
methods.description: Actions when a project is deleted.

methods.name: update_percent_complete
methods.description: Calculates and updates project completion percentage.

methods.name: update_costing
methods.description: Calculates project costing details.

methods.name: calculate_gross_margin
methods.description: Calculates the gross margin for the project.

methods.name: update_purchase_costing
methods.description: Updates total purchase costs.

methods.name: update_sales_amount
methods.description: Updates total sales amount.

methods.name: update_billed_amount
methods.description: Updates total billed amount.

methods.name: after_rename
methods.description: Handles renaming of the project.

methods.name: send_welcome_email
methods.description: Sends a welcome email to project collaborators.
